objective: Increase the capacity of v74's one-pass x8-by-128 mixed-cell representation at identical bytes by solving each candidate INT4 cell's eight FP16 row scales via exact conditional calibration least squares before greedy selection.

parent_finding.conclusion: Cell routing generalizes broadly, but source-weight INT4 scales leave deployable capacity unused. Optimize the already-stored scale values against activation residuals without adding codes, bytes, passes, or operations.

data_status.development_confirmation: 32 rows from four disjoint prompts first opened by v74
data_status.reason: v75's scale-optimization hypothesis was chosen after observing aggregate v74 confirmation metrics
data_status.allowed_use: reject or admit the algebra to a new-prompt replication only

int4_cell.codes: fixed signed INT4 source-weight codes in [-8, 7], group 128, from four deterministic weight-space scale iterations
int4_cell.stored_scales: one FP16 scale for each of eight output rows in a selected cell
int4_cell.scale_fit: for every candidate cell and output row, solve max(0, dot(z, residual plus removed-CQ3-cell-output) divided by dot(z, z)), round to FP16, then score the deployed rounded value
int4_cell.z: calibration activation dotted with the fixed signed INT4 code vector
int4_cell.learned_runtime_values: the same 81920 FP16 scales already counted by the INT4 cell format

canonical_layout.runtime_dispatch: unchanged mutually exclusive CQ3 or INT4 x8-by-128 cell execution in one down-projection pass

decision.if_pass: freeze the exact selected cells, INT4 codes, and optimized scales, then generate a new disjoint non-benchmark prompt cache and independently replicate before any multilayer promotion
decision.if_fail: reject fixed-code calibration-optimal cell scaling and move to a structured rotation or trainable cell codes without tuning this rate on the development confirmation

claim_boundary: Development-only layer-59 algebra screen on an architecture-contaminated confirmation set. A pass can only authorize a new-prompt replication; it cannot establish held-out quality, whole-model capability, benchmarks, throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
